messages:
Sasha: CI red on main, saw a failing snapshot in tests/inference/test_prompt_serialization.py::test_prompt_roundtrip. cc @mike @oliver — diff shows spacing/kv-cache ordering.

Mike: On it. Can you paste the failing diff and link to the pipeline?

Sasha: Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/12345/jobs/678 — snippet:
```
- prompt: \"Translate to French: Hello\"
+ prompt: \"Translate to   French:  Hello\"
```
Also got stack: serialization.serialize_prompt -> kv_cache order changed

Oliver: Huh, that's small whitespace but snapshot asserts exact. Any recent PRs touching serializer?

Anya: FYI I merged #3456 earlier; it changed float/str normalization for token attrs — could have impacted join/spacing. Noticed a warning in local runs.

Mike: Could be KV cache non-determinism. Sasha, can you rerun the job with env KV_CACHE=off and `PYTEST_ADDOPTS=\'-k test_prompt_roundtrip -q\'`? If green, we bisect.

Sasha: Kicking a manual rerun with KV_CACHE=off now. /cc @ci-bot

ci-bot: Rerun triggered by sasha for job 678 with env KV_CACHE=off — https://ci.redwood.internal/12345/jobs/679

Sasha: Job 679 finished — still failing. Pasting full diff:
```
--- expected
+++ actual
@@
-"Hello"
+"Hello\n"
```

Oliver: That newline is interesting. Might be serialization adding a trailing newline for certain token types. Mike, can you bisect between commit abc123 and def456? I can spare some minutes to watch.

Mike: Starting git bisect locally now. If anyone sees nondeterministic outputs across runs, try `REPLAY_SEED=42` and `PYTHONHASHSEED=0` — helps rule out hash-ordering.

Sasha: Noted. Also attach env: python 3.11.4, torch-nightly, quantization shim v2.1

Mike: Bisect: found first bad commit at b9f7c2 (PR #3456 merge). Looks like serializer changed join behavior. Repro in small script attached.

Anya: Ack. I'll open a patch to make serializer deterministic (strip trailing newline) and add snapshot update guidance in test. Should we revert PR or patch?

Oliver: Patch + stricter test (normalize whitespace) preferred, re-run CI after patch.

Mike: I'll draft PR, add `- normalize_whitespace` helper for the test so small formatting changes don't flake other times.

Sasha: Thanks team. @ci-bot please rerun downstream pipelines once PR is up.

ci-bot: Noted. Will trigger on PR open.

Mike: PR created #3489. Linking: https://git.redwood/3456/PR/3489

Sasha: Great. Marking this thread resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
